newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-NORWAY'S BROGELAND TO COACH LASK LINZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORWAY'S BROGELAND TO COACH LASK LINZ.

text.p: Per Brogeland, coach of Norwegian premier league club Lillestroem, said on Wednesday he would join combined Austrian first division club LASK Linz next season.
"When I got the chance to become chief coach for such an interesting concept I just couldn't say no," Brogeland, who signed a one year contract, told the Norwegian news agency NTB.
LASK Linz and FC Linz announced last month they would merge at the end of the season.
